content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element. 2. The claim's effect on the four variables of T-state is exactly the `undo` action in specs/markers/undo.qnt — the undone count one further back, the position to the pre-boundary of the operation it undoes, the redo bound set to the pair count when it starts from nothing-undone, the pairs unchanged. Fail on any diverging element — name it.
content.rationale: The undo effect is where the model's transition meets the variables it moves and the selection it reads; this check forces the claim to answer to the action it is read out of, from the artifact's side, without re-deciding the model.
